messages:
harper-finops: Morning folks — noticed two customers were invoiced twice for yesterday's usage batch. Amounts match exactly and timestamps are ~1m apart. Anyone touching the daily job overnight?

sam-eng: looking now. the usage-aggregate CronJob shows two successful runs: 2026-03-12T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-12T02:01:05Z. That 1m gap is suspicious. kubernetes shows previous run completed but controller started a new pod due to a missed termination hook.

levi-billing: that would explain duplicate invoices posted to NetSuite. Our batch posts use run_id + customer_id to construct external_id, but run_id being a timestamp to the minute could differ between the two runs causing two external_ids.

harper-finops: customers impacted: cust_92, cust_117. Both received duplicate invoices of their metered charges. Need reversal and apology.

sam-eng: immediate mitigation: disable the cron and start a single one-off job for today while we fix. I'll also add a DB-level distributed lock so only one runner can process a given run_date.

billing-batch-bot: Action: created ticket BILL-1302 - add distributed locking and idempotent external_id schema for usage batch postings. Enqueued dup_invoice cleanup job for cust_92 and cust_117.

levi-billing: for cleanup: create reversing credit memos in NetSuite referencing external_id of duplicate invoice and annotate memo: "Auto-reversal: duplicate from batch run 2026-03-12 due to cron overlap". Will also flag original invoice lines with note.

ana-acct: accounting sign-off needed for auto credit memos. We prefer reversing JE + new corrected invoice if amounts materially affect revenue recognition. For small metered charges, credit memos are fine. Please list amounts and customer approvals.

harper-finops: amounts are small: $12.34 and $7.89. I'll reach out to the two customers and confirm we will reverse the duplicate and apply credit.

sam-eng: fix outline: 1) change external_id to include deterministic batch_id (hash of date+job-config) instead of pod start time, 2) add a lease-based lock in Postgres using pg_try_advisory_lock for run_date, 3) add a K8s readiness/termination hook to ensure pods don't get killed mid-run, 4) add e2e test that simulates concurrent runners.

levi-billing: will also update NetSuite posting logic to be resilient: if external_id already exists, skip create and log. Right now it sometimes attempts update vs create mismatch.

billing-batch-bot: Scheduled job: BILL-1302-RECON (30m) to scan last 7 days for duplicate external_ids with same customer/amount and mark candidates for manual review.

harper-finops: timeline? customers want this sorted today.

sam-eng: I'll disable cron now and run single job. Lock patch PR will be up by EOD. Deployment to prod after tests tomorrow morning but disabling cron + db lock for today should mitigate.

levi-billing: I'll prepare the credit memos and reversal entries once the single run completes and confirm no further duplicates. Posting will include note: Stripe/Batch run duplicate reversal and reference to this thread.

ana-acct: accounting approves credit memos for the two small amounts. For any larger duplicates found by recon, we'll decide case-by-case.

harper-finops: thanks. I'll send customers the short note and cc billing team. Keep me posted on the PR and recon results.

sam-eng: done: cron disabled and one-off run completed successfully. No new duplicates generated. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/771 opened (lock + deterministic batch id).

billing-batch-bot: Action: duplicate cleanup completed for cust_92 and cust_117. Created credit memos NS-CR-20260312-001 and NS-CR-20260312-002.

levi-billing: credit memos posted and emails queued to customers. Running 7-day recon now; will post full results here.

harper-finops: excellent — thanks team :thumbsup:
